name: Marco Casagrande
biography: Marco Casagrande is a postdoctoral researcher in cybersecurity at the KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Sweden). He specializes in the security of real-world smart devices, including fitness trackers, FIDO authenticators, and electric scooters.
